record.body:
subject: verify-needs-you-phase
kind: deliver
result: fail
revision: 2066784 (no commit made; working tree restored clean)
evidence: New tmux popup test (patch saved at /tmp/verify-needs-you-tmux-test.patch). Ran it 20+ times with `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_tmux_integration.py -q -m tmux -rf -k finished_effort_last`. About 13-17 s per run. Once the test no longer assumed item order, it failed every time at the tab-to-finished-effort step. Pilot repro at /tmp/test_tab_bounce_repro.py (copy it into tests/ to run it): with no Needs you item, 1 passed; with one effort-level question on the live effort, 1 failed (active stays 'effort-beta'), with or without pressing n and esc first. Existing unit test `-k sorts_after_a_live`: 1 passed. I did not run the full suite because the phase test exposed a product defect.
observations: These steps pass in the popup. The Needs you list shows 3 items. n focuses the list. j moves the highlight. Enter on the task-linked finding (subject fx-ready) opens the fx-ready task detail. Esc returns. Enter on the effort-level question opens the Needs you detail with "question", "project:continuity-question" and the full text, which the list cuts off with an ellipsis. Esc returns to the list, and esc again returns to the table. The tab bar lists the finished effort after the live one ("⚠ tmuxfx donefx"). Pressing tab to move to the finished effort fails. The key log shows step_effort sets active to effort-donefx, then TabActivated fires for donefx and right away again for tmuxfx. Cause, from a set_focus trace: tab hides the live pane. Textual's Screen._reset_focus then moves focus from the hidden TaskTable to its sibling NeedsList in the same live pane. TabbedContent then switches back to the pane that holds the focused widget. The finished pane has no widget that can take focus (its task table is hidden), so nothing keeps the switch. Without Needs you items there is no sibling, and tab works. That is why the unit tests miss it. Other test-side findings, not defects: (1) The order of findings in Needs you depends on record id, so it changes between runs. Tests must pick items by text, not by index. (2) In the tmux popup, the escape byte of an arrow-key sequence sometimes reaches the app on its own. Esc on the Needs you list leaves the list, so the test must use j/k there. (3) After esc from a task detail opened from Needs you, focus goes to the task table, not back to the Needs you list. The code does this on purpose (TaskDetailScreen.action_back calls focus_tasks). (4) Widget.focus() takes effect later, so the test sleeps 0.5 s after n before it presses j. README: it documents n and the Needs you detail, but it does not mention finished efforts (dimmed, sorted last, "All N tasks done"). I did not add this because the task stopped.
verdict: fail
claim: Defect in scripts/dashboard_app.py: tab cannot switch from a live effort that has Needs you items to a finished effort. Focus falls back to the live pane's NeedsList, and TabbedContent switches back. Fix suggestion: in step_effort, or on TabActivated, set focus to None or to a widget in the new pane when its task table is hidden. Alternatively, make the finished pane hold a widget that can take focus. Add the Pilot repro as a regression test. No tmux flake seen apart from this failure.
needs_human: false
